type_definitions.name: LeanConsistencyDisposition

workflows.description: reference-free consistency testing over compiled Lean artifacts using local semantic comments, reverse informalization, non-vacuity, cross-file concept indexing, mathlib grounding, and monotone critic monitoring.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered lean_consistency_testing_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared lean_consistency_testing_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by lean_consistency_testing_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Recover compiled Lean meaning, test formal shape, source fidelity, and library coherence, and issue one reference-free report.
reasoning_projection.name: AssessLeanConsistency

occurrences.rationale: Reverse-informalize the declarations and retain their line-level explanations.
Assess compilation, declaration shape, non-vacuity, and artifact realness.
Assess internal meaning and agreement with source anchors.
Assess cross-file concepts and applicability of mathlib grounding.
Compare independent findings and expose agreement, disagreement, and drift.
Produce the unified consistency status and retain every blocking finding.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: reference-free consistency interpretation over compiled artifacts
